title: Answering Path Queries under Linear and Guarded Existential Rules
abstract: arXiv:2607.22636v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Ontology-mediated query answering is concerned with the problem of answering queries over knowledge bases consisting of a database instance and an ontology. While most work in the area focuses on conjunctive queries (CQs), navigational queries have gained increasing attention. In this paper, we investigate the complexity of answering two-way (conjunctive) regular path queries ((C)RPQs) over knowledge bases whose ontology is given by a set of guarded existential rules. We first consider the subclass of linear existential rules and show that (C)RPQ answering is NL-complete in data complexity, which matches the data complexity of answering RPQs over plain graph databases (i.e., without an ontology). In combined complexity, both tasks are ExpTime-complete in the general case, but RPQ and CRPQ answering drop to PTime-complete and PSpace-complete respectively if there is a bound on predicate arity. translated_title: 线性与受保护存在规则下的路径查询回答
translated_abstract: 本体中介的查询回答研究的是在由数据库实例和本体组成的知识库上回答查询的问题。虽然该领域的大多数工作聚焦于合取查询（CQ），但导航式查询正获得越来越多的关注。在本文中，我们研究了在本体由受保护存在规则集合给出的知识库上回答双向（合取）正则路径查询（(C)RPQ）的复杂性。我们首先考虑线性存在规则这一子类，并证明(C)RPQ回答在数据复杂性上是NL完全的，这与在普通图数据库（即不含本体）上回答RPQ的数据复杂性相匹配。在组合复杂性方面，这两种任务在一般情况下都是ExpTime完全的，但如果谓词的元数有界，RPQ和CRPQ回答则分别降至PTime完全和PSpace完全。对于受保护规则，我们提供了一个非平凡的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文证明了在线性存在规则下回答双向（合取）正则路径查询在数据复杂性上是NL完全的（与无本体的普通图数据库一致），在组合复杂性上一般为ExpTime完全（谓词元数有界时RPQ为PTime完全、CRPQ为PSpace完全），并为受保护存在规则情形给出了重要结果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that answering two-way (conjunctive) regular path queries over knowledge bases with linear existential rules is NL-complete in data complexity—matching plain graph databases—with combined complexity of ExpTime-complete in general, dropping to PTime-complete and PSpace-complete for RPQs and CRPQs under bounded predicate arity, and also establishes key results for guarded existential rules.
